description: This PHP source file defines the Magento controller class VacancyRestController for the Recruitment module in OrangeHRM. It handles REST API requests related to vacancies, specifically GET requests to retrieve vacancy details by ID. The class implements request handling methods, validation setup, and exception handling, and utilizes traits for service normalization and exception management.
